chat.t: Hello.
{player}, is this your number?
Oh, thank goodness.
I'm Treache. The one you met earlier at the Panoticon.
By the way...
Please apologize to me.
I said, apologize to me!!
Though, of course, I did let my guard down too.
To think I'd meet someone like you in the Panoticon.
Still, I'm glad I took the job.
Since there's now one more person who can actually see me.
Even so...
Please apologize to me.
For doubting me and body-searching me!!

o: I was just doing my job.

chat.t: Ugh...

lines.t: That was a day I dropped by the Panoticon to grab a bite.
Panoticon
Phew... Well, Master, I should be going now...Maid A
You absolutely mustn't break out of prison this time, okay?Maid A
You have to behave yourself, okay? Seriously, behave.Maid A
Alright, I get it.
(This should be enough.)
(Now that my stomach is full, shall I head back?)
...Huh?
Hmm, we were definitely supposed to meet here....
Hmm, we were definitely supposed to meet here....Maid A
Just when are they coming?Maid A
I-I'm right here....
U-Um, excuse me....
Sigh, let me contact them again—Maid A
E-Excuse me!
Kyaaaaaah!!Maid A
Hyeaaaaah!!!
Y-You startled me! Why would you scare me like that?!Maid A
T-T-That's my l-line...!
No, it's because you suddenly popped up behind me!Maid A
...Don't tell me,Maid A you're the carrier, Treache?Maid A
I-I've been behind you the whole time, though...
A-Anyway, y-yes, that's me.... Y-You ordered some goods, right?
W-What the... She suddenly disappeared!?Maid A
C-Could it be... a-a ghost??!!Maid A
Kyaaaaaaaaah!!!!!!Maid A
Sigh... this is h-happening again...
Hey.
Hyeaaaaaaah!!!!
Whoa, you scared me.
W-W-W-Who are you!!??
N-No... t-that's not what I mean...!
A-Are you... speaking t-to me...?
Who else would I be talking to here?
W-Wow. H-Heh...
Is that really so surprising?
O-Of course! Y-You're the ninth one, after all.
The ninth?
The ninth person to m-make conversation with me first.
Ah, um... i-it's not a weird story....
I-I have a constitution that naturally lacks presence...
S-So... someone noticing me first is r-really rare....
A-And that guard's reaction earlier is what I u-usually get...
A-Anyway... I'm g-glad to meet someone who speaks to me after so long... Heheh!
...Ah. W-What were we talking about?
What were you doing here anyway?
Doesn't sound like you're an inmate.
U-Um... well....
I-I'll tell you... so please, keep it a s-secret!
A-Actually, I was requested by the guards here... t-to smuggle items inside....
With my c-constitution, I can even bring in prohibited items...
Prohibited items?
Are you planning a terror attack or something?
Huh?! I-It's not a bad thing l-like that...!
E-Even if they're prohibited, they're j-just ordinary things...!!
T-There really is nothing to it!?
Treache showed the items she had brought.
...A bunny girl outfit?
What is this now?
Hmm, the smuggled goods really are nothing major.
I-I told you so....
Alright, next I'll be searching your body.
...Yes?
Well, you're suspicious, so I have to check.
You might have stolen something.
W-Wh-What!?!?
Your constitution seems perfect for that kind of thing.
(Flinch!)
A-A-Are you s-suspecting me!?
I-I didn't steal a-anything!
I-I just came here for a r-request...!
T-There's nothing worth s-stealing in a place like this anyway...!
So if there was something worth stealing, you would've?
T-T-That's not what I meant...!
If you have a clean conscience, it's fine.
H-Hnn... but still...
...O-Okay. I'll do it.
Ugh... I r-really didn't steal anything... I-I mean it....
Alright, shall we begin?
...What's this?
Why do you have a... graphics card in your bag?
Ah. T-This is just my hobby...
I-I'm serious....
I'll let it slide for now.
Ah, yes....
...Huh?
...B-But now that I think about it, w-who are you to do a body search—
Hnyah!!?
W-W-W-W-Why are you t-touching me there!?!?
Whoa, she suddenly vanished.
Y-Y-You're absolutely lying!!
T-T-There's nothing in a place like that!!!
Hee...! Ah, s... s-stop...
(Hmm, looks like she really doesn't have anything.)
Alright, you're free to go.
Ugh, uuu....
I-I'm never coming here again....
Well, I have things to do, so I'll be off.
I quickly got out of there before I could get blamed for anything.

chat.t: Hello.
I'm sorry, but could you help me out right now...?
There's no one else I can ask besides you...
I just need you to buy something for me.
It has to be someone who knows about my constitution...
Please help me!
Treache shared a photo.
Hehehe.
I set up the one I bought today.
Isn't it cute?
Are you actually looking?
I got suspected again today even though I didn't do anything...
And as if that wasn't enough, I got body-searched again.

o: Just forget about what's in the past.
Call me next time you need me to buy a figure for you.

chat.t: Huh?
Really?

o: I can do it once as a favor.

chat.t: Hehe.
You promised, okay!?

lines.t: I headed to the location Treache told me about.
Shopping District
H-Hello...!
W-Wh-What?!!
Ah, there you are.
S-Seriously...! P-Please don't scare me!
Y-You can see me, r-right...?
Never mind that, what's going on?
U-Um... well...
I-I came to the s-shopping district to buy something today...
But the clerk k-keeps failing to notice me....
C-Could you buy it for me instead...?
You called me all this way just for that?
Don't they have a kiosk or something?
W-Well...
Whenever I try to press it, i-it won't recognize me....
Huh? What do you mean?
Y-You see... just like how people c-can't see me...
M-Machines don't seem to recognize me either....
Like, automatic doors won't open... or elevator buttons won't press... things like that....
Are you sure that's just a constitution issue...?
Eh? I-Is it not...?
I-I've been like this since I was a kid...
Sigh, never mind....
Anyway, what do you want me to buy?
U-Um... a f-figure....
R-Rupa-chan... she's my favorite character...
They're r-re-releasing the bunny girl Rupa-chan from <The Midwinter Rabbit and Pareidolia>... so I have to buy it....
I-It's a low-to-mid-priced scale figure, but the facial details are insane...!
Heheh! From her legs to the angle of her pelvis, it's identical to the original art...
The painting is slightly shaded with a gradient, so when the light hits it... her skin looks incredibly beautiful...!?
A-And the pose! It perfectly recreates that legendary pose from the original work... heheheh!
I-It's not just a figure anymore... it's a piece of art? A masterpiece...?! Its very existence is noble—
Ah.
I don't really get what you're saying, but did you...
D-Don't tell me you like Rupa-chan too...!?
Did you steal one already?
Wh-Wh-What!?!?
H-H-How on earth did you jump to that conclusion?!
You know suspiciously too much about it.
Meaning you've already pulled off a heist.
N-No, I didn't!! This is just my hobby, so I only know a little bit about it!!
Y-You've been doubting me since last time...!
A-And above all, I don't steal figures!
Only figures?
(Flinch!)
...I-I'm just saying I'm that passionate about them!
P-Passionate enough to pay a fair price for them...!
In that case...
A body search shouldn't be an issue, right?
F-Fine! I'm innocent anyway...!!
Alright, shall we begin?
H-Humph! Search me all you want...!
Y-You have no idea how much I love figures!
Hmm...?
S-Something seems wrong about this—
Awawawa!! N-N-Not there—
Hey, stay still!
Eek!
H-Hnn....
I-I feel like this happened last time too...
Waaah!
W-Why are you doing this again?!
I told you to stay still.
I didn't do anything—
Quiet.
I'm going to search very thoroughly this time.
Don't think you're getting off easy.
I-I said I didn't do anything....
H-How could I even hide a figure in a place like that—
Hyaak!!
U-Ugh.... W-Why are you doing this again....
Stop tensing up.
H-How can I not tense up when you're doing this to me—
Quiet down, I said.
...Hmm, you really don't have anything.
Then why did you come here?
I-I told you... I came to buy a figure...
Oh, then you should've just said so.
I-I told you that from the very beginning!!??
Okay. It's the Rupa-chan Bunny Girl figure, right?
...Ughhh.
Y-You heard everything anyway...

chat.t: Hello.
Um...
I actually have something I want to talk to you about today...

o: What's this all of a sudden?

chat.t: I thought you would be the right person to tell...
About my actual goal.
H-Have you perhaps heard of it?
About a certain secret room that's supposed to be inside the Panoticon...
I thought you of all people might know about it.
Huh?
W-Weren't you a Panoticon guard?
Thank you so much for today.
I can't believe I got to see that legendary figure with my own eyes...
Now I can die happy...

o: You didn't secretly pocket it, did you?

chat.t: I told you, I didn't steal it!
To be honest, I did think about taking it...
But someone else might hear the rumors and come to see it, just like me...
And then they should get to see it too.
When I think about more people discovering the charm of Rupa-chan, I can live with that.
M-Maybe it would be better if I kept it after all...?
And then I could just start rumors that I have it...?
Um...
S-Should I go back and get it...?

lines.t: I headed to the meeting spot to meet up with Treache.
How did she even end up mistaking me for a Panoticon guard?
Panoticon
Phew... Well, Master, I should be going now...Maid A
You absolutely, definitely cannot break out of prison this time, okay?Maid A
You have to behave yourself, really, really behave, okay?Maid A
Alright, I get it.
H-Hello...!
E-Excuse me!!
Ah, there you are.
Y-You're lying...!
Y-You did the exact same thing last time too!!
You've got a good memory.
P-Please stop t-teasing me!
W-We have to talk about something important today...!
Ah, right.
Something about a secret room, was it?
B-Before that!
W-What's going on here!?
A-Are you really... n-not a Panoticon guard?
Honestly, I don't know why you'd think that in the first place.
I mean, anyone can see I'm not a maid.
W-Well, that's true, but...
Y-You frisked me when we met here last time...
Isn't t-that what guards do?
Ah, well, about that.
This is where my precious free meals are...
...Precious?
...A place filled with precious memories.
So I had no choice but to protect it.
P-Protecting a place with precious memories...
T-That's... I-I mean...
So y-you were just lying to m—
Anyway, let's get back to business.
What's this secret room all about?
...S-So you're really not a guard, then.
Then I-I should probably explain everything from the beginning...
Th-The secret room... is the whole reason I worked at the Panoticon.
I-I only came here because I'm interested in a certain <bouten>item</bouten> inside...
Don't tell me it's a Rupa-chan figure?
W-Wow! How did you know!?
(What else would it be?)
I-It's the Prisoner Rupa-chan Figure from the now-discontinued <Waltzing with You Beyond the Iron Bars> series—
Alright, spare me the details.
Where is this secret room anyway?
U-Um...
I h-haven't actually found it yet...
But I have a hunch—
So that's what it was.
Ah-wah!!?
I came by because I was worried Master would break out of prison again...Maid A
I never expected you to be plotting something like this.Maid A
And with...Maid A
Our <bouten>dear smuggler</bouten> no less.Maid A
Gasp!?
C-Can you actually s-see me...!?
Is this really the time for that?
Don't you want your figure?
H-Hup!!
R-Right! R-Rupa-chan is waiting for me...!
Perfect timing. Let's ask her.
Hehe...Maid A
It won't be that easy, you know.Maid A
Our mischievous Master and smuggler need to be punished.Maid A
This might sting a little!Maid A
Ugh... N-No way...Maid A
T-There! It's o-our victory!
N-Now tell us where the secret room is!
Heh... D-Do you really think I'll tell you?Maid A
...I-I guess we have no choice.
I r-really didn't want to resort to this, but...
What are you planning to do?
Th-This is all for Rupa-chan's sake...!
Ugh! What the...!
S-Spit it out!
O-Or I'll do something even worse to you!
I-I know how bad it is because I've experienced it myself!?
Do you really think she'll talk after just that...?
Kh...! Something like this is nothing!Maid A
Kyaah!Maid A
H-How could anyone do something so cruel...!Maid A
I-I don't want to do this either, you know!?
S-So hurry up and talk!
Ugh... You villain—Maid A
I s-said talk!
Heeey! W-Wait! I'll talk, I'll talk!Maid A
I-I think it's the Lost and Found! Maid AIt's on the first floor!Maid A
I-I saw a bunch of figures piled up there!Maid A
Th-The Lost and Found! Th-That sounds plausible...!
L-Let's go right away!
Wait, where did she go?
Panoticon Lost and Found
How is there so much stuff here...?
F-Found it!!!!!
Oh.
Th-This loose, baggy fit... and the detail on the hair parts is criminally good...!
Th-This detailed engraving that counterfeits can never replicate, and that perfect, subtle gaze...!
I-It's definitely the real deal! Th-The actual prison uniform Rupa-chan...! It's so precious!!
Alright, hurry up and take it.
Okay!!!
—No way!! I said I'm not stealing it!!!
So you're just going to look at it and leave?
Th-That was my plan from the very start!
I j-just... wanted to see if it actually existed... hehe...
I-I only wanted to confirm it with my own eyes...!
Heheh! Th-This is more than enough!
...J-Just taking a few photos will be plenty!
As she said that, Treache smiled with a brighter expression than I had ever seen on her.
After that, I listened to Treache's excited rambling about figures for a while before going back.
